name: prompt-input
purpose: The composer of a generative AI chat (ChatGPT, Claude.ai and Gemini composers, AI Elements PromptInput, Cloudscape prompt input): a text area that grows with the prompt up to `maxRows`, a toolbar under it, files attached by a button, by dropping them on the box or by pasting them, a model and mode picker, dictation, a voice-conversation control that stands in for Submit while the prompt is empty, a Submit control that becomes Stop while a response is generated, a secondary row under the box (a context picker, tools, links), an optional character limit with a counter, and constraint text under it all. Enter submits on a fine pointer; Shift+Enter adds a line; on a coarse pointer (a phone keyboard) Enter adds a line and Submit sends; an IME composition never submits. It is controlled: the owner holds the text and the files, receives `submit` with the trimmed prompt, its references and its files, and clears them. While `status` is `pending` or `streaming` the reader can keep typing the next prompt, but cannot submit it until the response ends or they press Stop. With `queueable` the owner keeps a queue of prompts to send after the response (TanStack AI `useChat` queues a `sendMessage` made while it streams): Submit then stays beside Stop, and Enter or Submit sends the next prompt into that queue while Stop still ends the response. The anatomy is composed by the app: the root draws the box, the text area, Submit / Stop / voice and the file tokens; the controls the app wants (attach, dictate, model, context, tools) are sub-components it places in the `actions`, `end` and `footer` slots. Each reads the composer through `provide` / `inject`, so the app wires nothing but its own values. At rest it is one floating bar (Attach `+`, the text, the `end` controls, Submit, voice or Stop) on a translucent raised surface with a shadow and a backdrop blur, so a thread can scroll under it. A second line, attached files or references, or an open shortcut menu stack it into two rows (text on its own row) until the prompt is cleared.
useWhen: The input of any conversation with the generative AI assistant.
A single "Ask about this page" box that opens a conversation.
avoidWhen: A text field in a form → `textarea` inside `field`.
Search over a list → `input` with a search icon or `property-filter`.
A file upload form → `file-dropzone` with `file-token-group` in a `field`.
related: `textarea` — the form control; this one has no visible label and submits on Enter.
`conversation` — the log above it; only the log scrolls.
`suggestion-group` — prompts the reader can send without typing.
`file-token-group` — what the attached files render as (horizontal, removable).
`file-dropzone` — the drop target for a page-wide drop; the composer box is its own drop target.
`dropdown-menu` — what the model, context and tools pickers open.
`select` (`variant="ghost"`) — a plain single choice the app adds to the toolbar itself.
bestPractices: Placeholder is a suggested question with no end punctuation (`Ask a question`); never the only instruction.
Put the disclaimer and the shortcuts in `hint`, not in the placeholder.
Set `status` from the request so Submit turns into Stop; wire `stop` to abort it.
Set `queueable` only when the owner queues what is sent while a response runs, and shows the
Clear `v-model` and `v-model:files` in the `submit` handler and keep focus in the input.
Use `maxLength` only when the backend has a limit; the counter is the warning, and it stays hidden

Default to the full composer in blocks and new AI surfaces (`PromptInput.AttachButton` in `actions`, `PromptInput.ModelPicker` and `PromptInput.DictateButton` in `end`, `voice`, `PromptInput.ContextPicker` and `PromptInput.Tools` in `footer`, and the disclaimer in `hint`); omit a control only when the product explicitly does not offer that capability. Attach goes first at the inline start; model, dictate and Submit at the inline end, in that order; the secondary row holds what is not about this prompt (where the chat lives, the tools, a link to the desktop app).
Show the upload state on each file (`loading`, `progress`, `error`); Submit waits for them.
Set `voice` only when the product has a voice conversation; Submit replaces it as soon as there is

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Hint shown while empty, a suggested question with no end punctuation. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Ask a question`).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the text area; the input has no visible label. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Prompt`).

props.name: maxLength
props.doc: Character limit; an `n/max` counter shows from 80% of it and submit is blocked over it. `0` means no limit.

props.name: maxRows
props.doc: Rows the text area grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: status
props.doc: Request lifecycle: `pending` and `streaming` swap Submit for Stop and block another submit (unless `queueable`); typing stays allowed.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the text area, the submit control and every control in the slots' rows.

props.name: menus
props.doc: Shortcut menus opened by a trigger character at the start of a word: `/` for commands, `@` for things to reference. Choosing an option inserts `<trigger><label>` and adds it to `references`.

props.name: accept
props.doc: File filter in the native accept syntax (extensions, MIME types, wildcards) for picked, dropped and pasted files. Empty accepts every file.

props.name: maxFiles
props.doc: Most files attached at once; files past it are rejected. `0` means no limit.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.doc: Largest file in bytes; larger files are rejected. `0` means no limit.

props.name: voice
props.doc: Shows a Start voice conversation control in place of Submit while there is nothing to send; it emits `voice-start`.

props.name: voiceActive
props.doc: Marks a live voice conversation as active: swaps the voice control to End voice conversation (`voice-end`) and disables `PromptInput.DictateButton` with a muted microphone icon.

props.name: queueable
props.doc: While `status` is `pending` or `streaming`, keeps Submit beside Stop and lets Enter submit, so the owner queues the prompt for after the response.

events.name: submit
events.payload: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent, payload: { value: string; references: PromptInputReference[]; files: PromptInputFile[] })

events.name: reject
events.payload: (event: Event, payload: { files: File[]; reason: PromptInputRejectReason })

slots.name: attachments
slots.notes: Attached context the app draws itself, above the text, before the file tokens and the references.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Controls at the inline start of the bar (`PromptInput.AttachButton`); inside a `fieldset` disabled with the input.

slots.name: end
slots.notes: Controls at the inline end of the bar, before Submit (`PromptInput.ModelPicker`, `PromptInput.DictateButton`); disabled with the input.

slots.name: footer
slots.notes: A secondary row under the bar (`PromptInput.ContextPicker`, `PromptInput.Tools`, links); wraps on narrow screens; disabled with the input. Optional: for the single-bar look, place the pickers in `actions` / `end` instead.

slots.name: hint
slots.notes: Constraint text under everything; referenced by `aria-describedby`.
